What does real value-based care look like? That was just one part of my conversation with James Hereford, CEO of Fairview Health. Check out this short podcast clip.

We also dig into the economics of specialty pharmacy/340B, and where Fairview Health has been able to win with AI. You won’t want to miss James’ conversation about his biggest AI implementation failures, the need to give employees agency, and the mistake most orgs make when they fall in love with technology.
